stories.title: Another blockbuster Supreme Court term in review
stories.summary: The Supreme Court's ruling that presidents can fire leaders of independent agencies — at will — could lead to less regulation of corporate interests.

stories.title: Victor Willis, former voice of The Village People and co-writer of 'Y.M.C.A.,' has died
stories.summary: Vocalist Victor Willis, the former lead singer of the disco band The Village people, has died. He was not only the front man but he also co authored several of the group's hits.

stories.title: In their seventh film, the minions make mayhem on the silver screen
stories.summary: Everybody's favorite yellow, pill-shaped pranksters go Hollywood in the 1920s in their seventh big-screen adventure, Minions and Monsters.

stories.title: Lessons learned from a decades-old heat tragedy help Chicago and other cities
stories.summary: A heat dome has sent temperatures spiraling in rural and urban areas. Local governments have issued warnings and set up ways for residents to cool off in an effort to prevent heat-related deaths.

stories.title: U.S. men's soccer star Christian Pulisic will take to the field after injury
stories.summary: Christian Pulisic, the longtime star of the U.S. men's national soccer team, has been slowed by an injury this World Cup. He's finally healthy and ready for his big moment.

stories.title: North Carolina's mountainous hills become proving ground for downhill skateboarding
stories.summary: The mountainous hills of Western North Carolina are welcoming athletes of a growing and dangerous sport -- downhill skateboarding.
